What We Do

Every phase of civil construction, under one roof.

We handle the full lifecycle of a build — planning, structural work, and finishing — so clients coordinate with one accountable team rather than a chain of contractors.

01

Residential Construction

New homes and residential complexes, built to approved structural drawings and local code.

02

Commercial Construction

Offices, retail spaces, and commercial facilities, delivered on schedule and on budget.

03

Structural Engineering

Design and analysis of load-bearing systems, foundations, and reinforced concrete structures.

04

Renovation & Remodeling

Structural upgrades, extensions, and interior remodeling for existing properties.

05

Site Development

Land grading, excavation, drainage, and site preparation ahead of construction.

06

Project Management

Single-point supervision across contractors, materials, and timelines from start to handover.

About Us

Two directors. One accountable team, on site.

NJV Constructions Pvt Ltd is a civil engineering and construction company handling projects from initial planning through to final handover, with in-house oversight at every stage.

The company is led by two directors who stay directly involved in project execution, rather than delegating oversight away from the people who commissioned the work.

Er. Naveen Kumar

Director, NJV Constructions Pvt Ltd · 9+ Years Experience

Director at NJV Constructions Pvt Ltd, overseeing civil construction, project execution, and quality management across residential, commercial, and turnkey projects.
